title: squalify must emit structural fingerprints and neutral detect-rule hints
lead: Computes the `layout`, `typed` and `names` fingerprints over value-free projections, plus the `hints` a consumer can turn into match rules. Each format family adds its own part of the projection through `IFingerprintContributor`.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** the contributions for Parquet, Touchstone/keyValue and STDF (added in sq-08, sq-09 and sq-10); header-unit convention hints (sq-14).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Goal: output that is useful for classification.

Owner decision (2026-10-13): three hashes. If a column is empty in one file, its type differs, so `typed` would split two files of the same type while `layout` keeps them together. `names` survives reordered columns.

The hints mirror DataBall's condition vocabulary without depending on DataBall: `extension`, `headerExact`, `headerContainsAll`, `lineMatches` with a 0-based line, `columnCount` and `parquetColumns` (`DataBall/src/DataBall/FileTypes/JsonFileType.cs:73-125`).

sections.heading: Files
Failing tests
sections.body:
1. `Fingerprint_SameLayoutDifferentValues_AllEqual`.
2. `Fingerprint_ColumnEmptyInOneFile_LayoutEqualTypedDiffers`.
3. `Fingerprint_HeaderCaseDiffers_Equal`.
4. `Fingerprint_ReorderedColumns_NamesEqualLayoutDiffers`.
5. `Fingerprint_NoValuesInProjection`: the projection bytes for a canary fixture do not contain `CANARY`.
6. `Hints_StableLines_RegexMatchesSourceLine_DotNetAndEcmaScript`.
7. `Hints_RequiredFields_NeverNull`.
8. The goldens are re-recorded and reviewed.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the tests.
2. Implement the projection, the contributor seam and the hints.
3. Mutation check: add the first data value to the projection, and test 5 must go red.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `dotnet build squalify.sln -c Release`
- `dotnet test squalify.sln -c Release`
- `dotnet format squalify.sln --verify-no-changes`
- If this slice changed architecture (the pipeline, an interface, a descriptor section or a determinism rule), `docs/how-it-works.md` and its diagrams are updated and `./scripts/render-docs.sh` has been re-run. The architect confirms there is no drift.
- `slicer check`

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Worktree `.worktrees/sq-06` on branch `sq-06`. No agent commits. After the gate returns `VERDICT: PASS`, the orchestrator commits `sq-06: fingerprints and hints` when the owner approves.
